articles.summary: We’ve recently integrated Prometheus (via the Pushgateway) as a publish-metrics plugin target. This makes it super easy for you to collect your test metrics on Prometheus. A logical next step would be to visualise those metrics to better make sense of how your tests performed.
articles.title: Grafana dashboards for your Artillery metrics in Prometheus
